descriptors: Frozen eleven descriptors, class centering/scales/PC1 on clipped rounded RGB
raw_RMS: Raw generated values affinely (x+1)/2; may extend outside nominal [0,1]
clipped_RMS_and_diversity: Floating affine RGB clipped with np.clip((raw.astype(float64)+1)/2,0,1), without PNG quantization
aggregation: Four variants averaged per source then summarized across302 sources/direction/arm
diversity: Mean six pairwise pixel RMS; raw and clipped separately; not semantic diversity
tail_selection: Four largest unique-source raw RMS then four distinct smallest clipped latent diversity
review: Small unblinded AI review; no class accuracy/FID claims
